titles.romaji: Shin Maple Town Monogatari: Palm Town-hen
titles.native: 新メイプルタウン物語 パームタウン編

description: The story take place in new town called " Palm Town " which it is the new town that patty and her Aunt Jane move on to live there because Jane's husband George run a medical center there, however patty face some troubles cause she didn't get used to this new town and miss her hometown and also her friends but she mets up with Alice and then she get along with her and soon they become best friends so everyday they hang out together experience new things and enjoying there time and met a different people in order to make a lots of friends and unforgettable memories full of fun.
